config.description: List of key-value configuration options, matching Fossil's `fossil set` command syntax.

enable_https.description: Whether to enable HTTPS using a certificate and key.

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format). Only used if `enable_https` is true.

ssl_key_file.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM format). Only used if `enable_https` is true.

extra_repos.description: List of additional repositories to register with the fossil server instance.
